verdict.rationale: E2B's core purpose is running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes. The docs state that code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM rather than on your server, with outbound network controls via an on/off switch or allow/deny lists, and a simple create/runCode API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation strength, and detailed security-model documentation (e.g., escape guarantees or a threat model).

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute untrusted, AI-generated code without risking my own infrastructure

citations.quote: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
your agent's code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of your server, with a real Debian toolchain, pause/resume persistence, and outbound network controls
With the E2B backend, the agent's built-in tools all execute inside an isolated sandbox instead of your machine
Control and restrict it with a simple on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists.
You can use E2B Sandbox to run AI-generated code to analyze data.
